description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Dark Focus

Benefit: As long as you have a dark spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can obscure the vision of a subject within 30 feet as a standard action, causing it to treat all other creatures as concealed and take a -5 penalty on Perception checks for 1 round on a failed Will save. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting dark spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Dark Focus
